image_description: A lionfish swimming in an underwater reef environment. The fish displays characteristic red, white, and brown vertical stripes. It has large, fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays and a dorsal fin with prominent spines. The background consists of yellow sponges and rocky coral structures.
